about: Hand decisions about MH1 stat blocks, applied by scripts/msh/roster.py after scripts/msh/coverpanels.py parses them. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - ranks, numbers and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: a card or one-line grid; page is the printed page, or null for a card on a cover panel (which prints no page)
verdict   as_printed        the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
checked   the date the page image was read

overrides.note: Inside back cover: Reason is printed as a question mark, and the card prints no Karma, Resources or Popularity, so MH1 has nothing to settle it (MHSP1's Karma 40 did). Played as Shift 0, applying Nate's 2026-09-28 ruling on the same printed value in MHSP1 (mhsp1-overrides.json); Karma is left unset. The card's Health 48 = F 6 + A 30 + S 2 + E 10, as printed.
